item.title: Version 1.1.17
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.17

  • Faster Watchlist Switching: Reduced repeated table work and reused prepared row data when moving between watchlists.
  • Synchronized Watchlist Lanes: Fixed vertical scrolling so both lanes stay aligned after switching watchlists.
  • Cleaner Volume Columns: Removed 50D Vol and 50W Vol from watchlist and portfolio tables and their column selectors.
  • More Efficient Price Charts: Reused cached history and moved sparkline preparation off the main UI path.
